findings.title: Credential-like literal assigned in source
findings.explanation: A credential-related name is assigned a literal value. Quoted assignments are checked in source/configuration, and plain values are also checked in .env files. FUSE cannot determine whether the value is valid or used.
findings.potential_impact: If the value is an active credential and the code or firmware is distributed, an unauthorized party may recover it and access the associated service or device.
findings.remediation: Remove the literal, rotate the value if it was exposed, and provision secrets through a deployment-specific secret store or protected device provisioning flow.
